text: ANDREY: text nowhere on the canvas is selectable/copyable — cannot copy anything. Make node body/section/stride text user-selectable without breaking pan/drag (selection on text, pan on empty).

§32.6 done — .ct-canvas-text { user-select:text; cursor:text } islands in globals.css + data-canvas-selectable on titles/digests/bodies/intent/rationale/strides/handoff text; root cause was body{user-select:none}+container; pan stays middle/space so left-drag selects+copies
CSS pointer/select split (no overlay) per spec; overlay was the rejected fallback
